title: Road Hazard Protection: One Open Certificate per Tire Set
content:
**Rule.** Road Hazard Protection certificates are aggregated per covered tire set. A tire set may carry only one certificate in status pending or active. A second plan for the same set is never sold alongside the first; a holder who wants a longer plan cancels the first certificate under the cancellation terms and buys the new one, inside the new plan's purchase window.

**What the records must show.** The check is made on the company's certificate records before the sale, matched on the tire set: if the set already carries a certificate whose status is pending or active, no further certificate is sold for it. A certificate in status expired or cancelled does not occupy the set.

**Tires covered.** Because every plan covers the whole set only, the number of tires covered equals the covered set's tire count, less one when the set includes a full-size spare and the plan does not cover the spare.

| Set's existing certificate | A new certificate for the same set |
|---|---|
| none | may be sold (subject to the purchase terms) |
| pending | not sold |
| active | not sold |
| expired or cancelled | may be sold (subject to the purchase terms) |

*Hypothetical counts.* A ticket of four tires with no spare: four tires covered. A ticket of five tires including a matching full-size spare: five tires covered on a plan that covers the spare, four on a plan that does not.
